CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFGRIDCOLUMN

CFGRIDCOLUMN, nested in CFGRID, chooses which query column a grid column shows and how: its header, width, alignment, whether it is visible or editable, and where its cells link.

Category

Forms

Syntax

<CFGRIDCOLUMN NAME="column_name"
    HEADER="header"
    WIDTH="pixels"
    DATAALIGN="Left/Center/Right"
    DISPLAY="Yes/No"
    SELECT="Yes/No"
    HREF="URL"
    HREFKEY="column_name"
    TARGET="window_name"
    NUMBERFORMAT="format"
    TYPE="type">

Attributes

NAME
Required. Name of the query column (or of the CFGRIDROW field) shown in this column.
HEADER
Optional. Column heading. Defaults to NAME.
WIDTH
Optional. Column width in pixels.
DATAALIGN
Optional, default "Left". Left, Center or Right.
DISPLAY
Optional, default "Yes". No hides the column. A hidden column still travels with the grid, so it can serve as HREFKEY or as the key for CFGRIDUPDATE.
SELECT
Optional, default "Yes". In EDIT mode, No makes the column read-only. Use it for key columns.
HREF
Optional. URL the cells of this column link to; overrides the grid's HREF.
HREFKEY
Optional. Column whose value is passed as CFGRIDKEY; overrides the grid's HREFKEY.
TARGET
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
NUMBERFORMAT
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it. Format values in the query or with NumberFormat before filling the grid.
TYPE
Optional. Image or numeric column type of the applet. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.

Usage

The applet's font, color and header-styling attributes (FONT, FONTSIZE, BOLD, ITALIC, TEXTCOLOR, BGCOLOR, HEADERFONT, HEADERALIGN, VALUES, VALUESDISPLAY and friends) are accepted for compatibility and ignored.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFPARAM NAME="URL.CFGRIDKEY" DEFAULT="">

<CFQUERY NAME="GetCourses" DATASOURCE="cfsnippets">
SELECT Course_ID, CorNumber, CorName, CorLevel, CorDesc
FROM CourseList WHERE Dept_ID = 'CS' ORDER BY CorNumber
</CFQUERY>

<H3>Computer Science courses</H3>
<CFFORM NAME="Catalog" ACTION="cfgridcolumn.cfm">
<CFGRID NAME="CourseGrid" QUERY="GetCourses" WIDTH="440">
  <CFGRIDCOLUMN NAME="Course_ID" DISPLAY="No">
  <CFGRIDCOLUMN NAME="CorNumber" HEADER="No." WIDTH="40" DATAALIGN="Right">
  <CFGRIDCOLUMN NAME="CorName" HEADER="Course (click for details)"
      HREF="cfgridcolumn.cfm" HREFKEY="Course_ID">
  <CFGRIDCOLUMN NAME="CorLevel" HEADER="Level" DATAALIGN="Center">
</CFGRID>
</CFFORM>

<CFLOOP QUERY="GetCourses">
  <CFIF Course_ID EQ URL.CFGRIDKEY>
    <CFOUTPUT><P><B>CS #CorNumber#, #CorName#:</B> #CorDesc#</CFOUTPUT>
  </CFIF>
</CFLOOP>
